description: Na₂Mg(NiO₂)₂ crystallizes in the hexagonal P̅6m2 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Mg and six equivalent O atoms. All Na-Mg bond lengths are 1.93 Å. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.28 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form distorted edge-sharing NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.55 Å. Mg is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na and six equivalent O atoms. All Mg-O bond lengths are 2.28 Å. Ni is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.07 Å) and three longer (2.56 Å) Ni-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na, three equivalent Mg, and three equivalent Ni atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded to three equivalent Na and three equivalent Ni atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing ONa₃Ni₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 45°.
